signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Set the goals, roadmap, and success criteria for your product area organized around short-term delivery and long-term strategy.
Actively contribute to the growth of the PM discipline and craft, mentor and empower our junior team members to excel in their roles.
Ensure successful product launch and lifecycle, with success defined as achieving desired business outcomes and product KPIs.
Engage directly with customers and prospects to understand core problems and translate them into customer needs that empower designers, data scientists, and engineers.
Work closely with cross-functional teams (sales, customer success, and product marketing) to understand the industry, competitor trends, and market dynamics.
